uncited: This method loads camera poses, intrinsics, and 3D point clouds from various SfM/MVS formats (COLMAP, instant-npg/sdfstudio), normalizes them to a canonical coordinate system, and resizes input images to a target resolution.
It ensures all camera poses are in a consistent 4x4 matrix format and scales intrinsics to match the resized image dimensions.

It differs from [Voxel Grid Generation & Expansion](2979-voxel-grid-generation-expansion.md) by focusing on the initial ingestion and normalization of scene geometry rather than the construction of the voxel grid itself, and from [DCX Pipeline](3770-dcx-pipeline.md) by handling raw SfM outputs directly without intermediate DCX-specific transformations.
- Camera poses and intrinsics from `.npy` files (instant-npg/sdfstudio format) or `.json` files (instant-npg/sdfstudio format) or COLMAP binary/text models.
- Image files corresponding to the camera poses.
- A list of `CameraInfo` objects containing normalized rotation matrices, translation vectors, resized intrinsics, and image paths.
- Precision issues when scaling intrinsics and poses.
- Boundary conditions when handling images with different aspect ratios.
- **Time Complexity:** Linear with respect to the number of images and points, $O(N_{images} + N_{points})$.
- **Memory Complexity:** Linear with respect to the number of images and points, $O(N_{images} + N_{points})$.
- **Measured Performance:** Not given in the sources.
- **Strengths:** Handles multiple input formats (COLMAP, instant-npg/sdfstudio), normalizes poses and intrinsics, resizes images.
- **When to use:** When preparing scene data for volume rendering or neural rendering pipelines from SfM/MVS outputs.
- **When not to use:** When dealing with distorted camera models that require undistortion before processing.
This method is commonly used in neural rendering and volume rendering pipelines to preprocess SfM/MVS data.
It builds on [Voxel Grid Data Generation Pipeline](1208-voxel-grid-data-generation-pipeline.md) by providing the initial normalized scene data.
